diagram_math_checks.result: The contract fixes Theta_h=R^m, V_h=R^n, Y_h=R^s with Euclidean inner products, Q_h closed convex in Theta_h. R_h:O_h x V_h -> V_h, G_h:O_h x V_h -> Y_h, S_h:O_h -> V_h, F_h=G_h(q,S_h(q)); D_q R_h transpose sends V_h to Theta_h, and (D_u R_h)^T p_h=nabla_u J_h. The diagram introduces no different spaces, adjoint conventions or operator arrows; its arrows are procedural transitions.

Contract defines Phi_h(q)=1/2 ||F_h(q)-y^delta||^2 + alpha/2 ||q-q_0||^2 and interval containment ell_h(q)<=Phi_h(q)<=u_h(q). Step 7 accepts the first changed admissible projected q_j=P_Q_h(q-(2^{-j}/L) g_tilde_h) satisfying u_h(q_j)<=ell_h(q). The flowchart uses that exact upper-versus-lower inequality, not the reverse, and its caption retains changed/admissible and first-accept conditions. L remains a positive scale, with no Lipschitz or convergence assertion.

Steps 1 and 2 have the shown inadmissible exits; step 2 also budget-exhausted. Step 3 has only linear-solve-failed for unsuccessful/invalid certificates. Step 4 projection/budget failure precedes its converged test rho_tilde+epsilon_g<=tau_g. Step 5 follows only if step 4 does not return and uses d^+<=kappa delta for discrepancy-stopped. Step 6 checks outer limit before current objective evaluation and can return budget-exhausted or linear-solve-failed. Steps 7-8 have exactly those same two terminal statuses. Each of the seven rightward arrows lists precisely the associated stage statuses; the caption explicitly leaves conditions and within-stage precedence to the unchanged Definition.

The sole backward edge runs from accepted projected trials (steps 7-8) into step 2, with q:=q_j and next k. Step 7 rejection advances j only, as the caption states; exhausting its N_backtrack trials returns budget-exhausted, not another outer iteration. Step 6 already excludes k=N_iter before an accepted trial, so the return never increments beyond the allowed range. Converged certifies only discrete projected residual via the supplier proposition, and discrepancy-stopped only discrete data discrepancy; no minimizer, mesh guarantee or iteration convergence is depicted.

The complete original algorithm is byte-preserved and supplies every condition and exit. The new caption explicitly declares the diagram illustrative and independent of the procedure/certificate guarantees. The local supplier proposition and reduced-gradient lemma proofs are unchanged and do not use the figure.
